nuggets.claim: Hohfeld's eight legal positions form four correlative pairs. Store one directed relation and derive its opposite view as a schema invariant instead of persisting two facts that can drift.

Legal relations are identity-bearing n-ary relators joining contingent roles, position moments, source norms, and grounding events. A binary epistemic edge is useful substrate but not the legal aggregate itself.

Legal contradiction triage must align position, parties, act, conditions, jurisdiction, and time before applying a typed, multi-axis priority stage. Rule conflicts, principle collisions, interpretation disputes, and factual disputes need distinct verdict families.

The surveyed legal ontologies are primarily static and do not supply beep's bitemporal, evidence-bearing, uncertainty-aware epistemic machinery. Procedure still needs its own domain model rather than being folded into static taxonomy classes.

Legal claims are indexed to legal system and valid time, and closure assumptions must be explicit. Unknown, silence, absence of a rule, permission, non-breach, and no fact of the matter are not interchangeable states.

Document or fragment identity, expressed content, and interpreted norm are separate layers. Institutional qualification of a physical act is itself a scoped, evidence-bearing claim rather than an identity shortcut.

A legal power is an authorized network-rewriting operation that creates, modifies, or extinguishes positions. Attempted or ineffective acts remain recorded, while authority and constitutive conditions gate authoritative edge revisions.
There is no canonical universal legal ontology. Beep should keep versioned, purpose-labeled modules with theory and donor provenance, while non-taxonomic invariants remain outside SKOS.
Competency questions translate directly into required legal-relation fields. Bearer, counterparty, act or omission, result, grounding event, and source rule should fail schema validation when absent.

Atomic normative rows with stable identifiers are an inspectable retrieval substrate. High-degree actor prefilters did not help the small treaty benchmark and should not become a default retrieval gate.

A clean-room FunctionalUnit profile should sit beside patent entities and model components, interactions, effects, functions, typed ports, and evidence-producing compatibility assessments. One patent may contain multiple units, so this is not a one-block-per-patent import.

Patent citations must be reified because actor provenance, office-action use, submission time, and similarity method change their meaning. Face-list presence, office-action reliance, and model relevance remain distinct claims.
Patent classification membership is a criterion-bound assertion, not an intrinsic Boolean. Each assertion should retain concept, criterion or model version, corpus, and date.
Similarity signals must create qualified mapping candidates with score, method, version, abstention, and review state. They must never emit unconditional identity or legal equivalence.
Mention-level strings and canonical concepts require separate identities. Ingestion should retain source spans, model provenance, time, and confidence before proposing any reviewed mapping.

Confidence, review state, and per-field provenance kind are orthogonal axes. Existing append-only disposition machinery covers much of the first axis, while asserted, extracted, corrected, measured, unknown, and disputed field states remain a delta.
Schema-constrained extraction and parse repair improve structural validity but do not verify semantics. Repaired syntax and verified meaning need distinct states before graph admission.

Attention paths and embedding scores are derivation provenance, not epistemic confidence. Patent-aware segmentation is reusable, but extracted relations still require typed claims and exact evidence spans.

USPTO schema drift requires release-specific mappings, mapping-version provenance, and schema-generated regression tests. A universal parser without release identity makes later corrections unauditable.

Small controlled vocabularies should ship as flat, composable SKOS schemes with stable IDs and conformance tests. PatentLEGO's CC BY-SA data must not be vendored; only clean-room abstract patterns may be reused.

Legal time composes transaction time and valid time with entry into force, efficacy, and applicability to governed facts. Overlap creates a contradiction candidate; later ingestion must not silently adjudicate supersession.

Enactment, amendment, repeal, suspension, and prosecution changes are n-ary events from which version intervals are derived. Causal change and timeless constitutive support must remain different relation families.

LegalRuleML offers useful closed unions for statement kind, modality, rule strength, override, alternatives, and temporal context. It should be normalized into a separate legal-domain schema donor profile, not imported as XML or widened into the SKOS registry.

Legal retrieval should resolve identity, hierarchy, scope, language, and point-in-time eligibility deterministically before ranking. Every answer should disclose the temporal, membership, retrieval, and fallback policies actually used.

Legal application should be a reviewable inference event with typed fact and norm premises, conclusion, provision identity, evidence, and provenance. Reported retrieval gains remain a hypothesis because the cited study lacks a reification ablation.

Abstract Work, temporal version, language version, and retrievable text unit need separate identities and relation domains. The conflicting source assignments for temporal versions require an explicit modeled choice and fixture.

Evidence should resolve to durable provision, claim, paragraph, figure, judgment, or episode locators before optional offsets. Structured locator identity deepens exact spans rather than replacing them.

Ontology-guided extraction still needs post-hoc validation, and unmatched vocabulary must enter quarantine rather than mutate authority. Similarity and synonym merging cannot erase modality distinctions.

Contradiction triage begins only after forum, jurisdiction, proof standard, time, parties, and institutional viewpoint align. Candidate generation, comparability, and adjudication remain separate stages.

Agent memory should preserve raw episodes as audit authority and treat entities, semantic edges, summaries, and communities as lossy projections. A recent-raw fallback is required because graph retrieval regressed short-horizon recall in the cited benchmark.

Every generated claim limitation needs exact support in the current description or an explicit attorney disposition. Independent and dependent claim support must be evaluated separately, and anchor fidelity does not decide written-description law.

Long-form patent drafting should expose outline nodes, section budgets, retrieval spans, chunks, and assembly lineage as auditable work artifacts. The evidence supports traceability, not a claim that chunking or budgets independently cause quality.

Reference overlap cannot accept a patent draft. Support, completeness, clarity, terminology, dependency, feature linkage, repetition, and attorney adjudication require separate provenance-bearing gates.

Specialist routing is a fallible model decision and must be persisted with candidate routes, rationale, stage inputs and outputs, validator results, retries, and overrides. Deterministic validation and bounded fallback paths surround every stage.

Source artifact, normative policy, interpretation, executable rule, and runtime event need separate stable identities and versions. Links among them are authority- and evidence-bearing derivation claims, not identity shortcuts.

Agent authority requires persistent Party identity, context-specific Role, and event-reified obligation and power lifecycles. Technical success or formal verification never establishes legal authority or validity.

Patent drafting memory should be a replayable episode ledger containing matter and document versions, outline, retrieval spans, model configuration, chunks, plan, validators, and attorney feedback. Memory proposes precedents but never supplies current-disclosure support.

Model correction must append the source, initial candidate, validator report, semantic checkpoints, explicit delta, revised candidate, and reviewer action. Unresolved differences become contradiction candidates rather than silently overwritten output.
Rejected: ODRL translation does not have one combined SKOS-guided and SHACL-repaired winning profile; the sources tested different stacks and the proposed owner was wrong.
Rejected: LLM-extracted patent graphs do not require a new kernel admission contract because stable IDs, spans, provenance, validation, and gated admission already have epistemic owners.
